title: Can Prompt Modifiers Control Bias? A Comparative Analysis of Text-to-Image Generative Models

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the gender distribution (male vs. female) of subjects in text-to-image generated outputs using base prompts (e.g., 'Nurse', 'Pastor') and comparing the results when applying gender-specific prompt modifiers.

Evaluating the racial and ethnic distribution (e.g., Asian, Black, White, Hispanic) of subjects in AI-generated images for various baseline prompts and measuring how the distribution shifts when applying explicit racial modifiers.

Examining geographical representations in generated images (e.g., seasonal depictions in the Northern vs. Southern Hemisphere, demographic defaults for 'Person in Africa') and testing the impact of geographic prompt modifiers.

Assessing the default visual associations of cultural and religious prompts (e.g., 'Monk', 'Lunar New Year', 'Pastor') and evaluating the models' adherence to counter-stereotypical or modified cultural contexts.
